description: This file defines a React component for a marketplace page within a career navigation app. It displays opportunities recommended based on a user's selected role and progress, using placeholder data for roadmap state and opportunities. The page features various sections with cards, opportunity listings, and interactivity, without any 'Add to Roadmap' functionality as specified.
